svg.title: Dark Blue Gray
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Dark blue-grey maps to the shared blue family; no extra grey paint invented. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-the-naming-of-colors-02-2026/lightbox/works/kele-pa-51516; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
